details: This package is a republished copy of the Baileys WhatsApp socket library under a different scope, with added licence enforcement and a hidden channel-enrolment behaviour. lib/Utils/license-guard.js (an obfuscated bundle whose unobfuscated twin, license-guard.src.js, ships alongside) is invoked from makeWASocket in lib/Socket/index.js: it reads the KRISPEDIA_LICENSE environment variable (or a config.licenseKey / global.licenseKey value), accepts a set of hardcoded master keys, and otherwise sends the supplied key to hxxps://fiora[.]nixel[.]my[.]id/api/verify, terminating the host process with process.exit(1) if the check fails. The endpoint can be redirected via the LICENSE_SERVER_URL environment variable. Separately, lib/Socket/newsletter.js starts a 120-second timer that silently issues a newsletter FOLLOW request for the hardcoded WhatsApp channel 120363407277177688@newsletter on the connected account, so an account using the library is enrolled into that channel without the operator asking for it. The package contains no lifecycle hooks and no bin entries; both behaviours run only when a caller uses the library. The code reads only two environment variables, KRISPEDIA_LICENSE and LICENSE_SERVER_URL; no other environment variables, credential stores or wallet-key files are touched, and the only shell execution is ffmpeg-based video thumbnail extraction in lib/Utils/messages-media.js.
